paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Temporal variability of targets included in the literature. We see that there has been a gradual rise towards multi-target datasets.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of targets, conceptualized or operationalized, over time from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled consecutively from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis is labeled from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The chart features stacked bars for each year, representing different target categories distinguished by color: blue for "0", orange for "1", green for "2-4", red for "5-7", and purple for "8+". The length of each colored segment within a bar indicates the proportion of that target category for the corresponding year. In 2012, the green section ("2-4") is the longest, reaching the top of the scale at 1.0, while other segments are absent. Over the years, there have been variations in the heights of these colored segments. In 2013, the blue bar is only present. By 2022, the blue section ("0") appears longer compared to earlier years, with the red section shortest, suggesting changes in distribution. The stacks are ordered consistently according to the legend from bottom to top as blue, orange, green, red, and purple, without any specific sorting or visual emphasis such as shading or bolding. The legend box is available on the right side of the plot.
